title: Swipe between screens
items: Swipe left or right to move between Now, Health, History, Apps and Settings; Back returns to Now
App usage now shows how much of your battery each app actually used (for example 3.2%), instead of its share of the drain
The total at the top shows how much battery was used in the period, and each app still shows its share of use underneath

title: A new icon
items: New app icon: the Liquid Orb, a glass orb of charge with a level ring and bolt
Matching themed icon for Android 13+ when you turn on themed icons
The splash screen shows the new icon too

title: Updates that just install
items: Every build is now signed with the same key, so future updates install straight over the old version and keep your battery history, settings and permissions
One last time: uninstall your current Bataria before installing this version

title: Hello, Bataria
items: Battery Pulse is now called Bataria
Your phone is recognised automatically so battery health works right away: Pixel 4a through Pixel 10, Galaxy S21 through S25, Galaxy A and Z series, and recent OnePlus phones
The welcome tour now asks Android directly to let Bataria run unrestricted in the background, and shows when it's done
Fixed hard-to-read dark text in the welcome tour and charger tester

title: App drain, charger tester and new widgets
items: New Apps tab: see which apps used the most battery today, in the last 24 hours or over a week (needs Usage access, stays on your phone)
Charger tester: measure any charger and cable in 30 seconds, rate it, and compare all your chargers side by side
Two new widgets: Battery ring (small circular gauge) and Battery chart (level, time left and the last 24 hours)
Floating navigation now fits five tabs

title: Welcome tour, Active apps and changelogs
items: New first-launch tour: what the app does, how health is measured, and guided setup for your look, monitoring and alerts
Live monitoring now explains that it shows in Android's Active apps, with a shortcut to hide its notification while it keeps running
The floating bottom bar is now frosted glass like the rest of the app
What's new appears after each update, and the full changelog is in Settings › About
Replay the tour any time from Settings › About

title: Animated backgrounds and custom colors
items: 7 animated backgrounds: Aurora, Bubbles, Constellation, Waves, Pulse, Grid and Space, with live previews
11 accent colors (or your wallpaper), each generating a full Material 3 palette
Frosted-glass cards, floating pill navigation bar, staggered card entrances and rolling numbers
The battery liquid tilts with your phone
Spelling: Battery optimization

title: Quiet monitoring
items: No more constant notification: monitoring runs quietly every 15 minutes by default
Optional live mode with live stats and instant alerts
"Fuel gauge" is now called "battery" throughout

title: The big redesign
items: Animated liquid battery gauge and expressive wavy health gauge
Home screen widget in Material You colors
Charge-limit, low-battery and temperature alerts
Live charging panel, screen-on vs screen-off drain, health trend and charge ratings
Interactive charts you can press and drag, plus pure-black dark mode

title: First release
items: Live current, power, voltage and temperature
Battery health measured from real charges
History charts and background monitoring
